title: Double Integral over a Triangular Domain
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate iint_T xy dA where T is the triangle with vertices (0, 0), (1, 0), and (1, 2).

steps.title: Define Region Boundaries
steps.explanation: The hypotenuse connects (0, 0) to (1, 2) with equation y = 2x.

steps.title: Evaluate Iterated Integral
steps.mathExpression: \int_0^1 \int_0^{2x} xy \, dy \, dx = \int_0^1 x \left[ \frac{y^2}{2} \right]_0^{2x} dx = \int_0^1 x \left( \frac{4x^2}{2} \right) dx = \int_0^1 2x^3 \, dx = \left[ \frac{x^4}{2} \right]_0^1 = \frac{1}{2}
steps.explanation: Perform inner y-integration then outer x-integration.
